cold_after_idle.note: Cancelled at the first harness timeout; late interpretation discarded. Retained separately, not part of the completed 30-trial warmed baseline.

limitations: Report uses conventional median (average of middle samples), correcting the original harness's upper-middle calculation. p95 uses nearest rank.
Saved synthetic speech and real-time waveform sampling, not live microphone trials.
Decision endpoint is native intent observed with 40ms polling, not audible onset.
Speech fixtures are identical; model dialogue history differs between running sessions.
Pause threshold remains 900ms; no timing target or physical threshold was relaxed.
First recognition after restart took 952ms; semantic fallback first decision took 3716ms.
Baseline negatives failed 3/3 by reusing the preceding screwdriver request. Post-change explicit declines are non-physical answers; semantic and multiple requests retain model interpretation.
